profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit AI safety and research company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company's primary public-facing product is Claude, an AI assistant the company describes as built for problem solvers, with capabilities spanning complex reasoning, data analysis, and code writing. Anthropic also offers the Anthropic Console, a developer-facing platform for API management, prompt testing, evaluation, usage monitoring, and cost controls, as well as Claude Code, an agentic coding tool, and a Computer Use agent that enables desktop automation and computer control.

On the legal front, Anthropic faces a substantial volume of litigation, with 139 cases tracked under California law exposure alone. Active suits span multiple federal courts and include Edelson, PC, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC in the Ninth Circuit, University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC in the District of Delaware, and a cluster of cases in the Northern District of California including Smith v. Anthropic, PBC, Patel v. Anthropic, PBC, Pascual v. Anthropic, PBC, Shakespeare v. Anthropic PBC, and Kahn v. Anthropic PBC, among others in Vermont, Hawaii, and Pennsylvania.
